name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Central government scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary education.
documents: Aadhaar Card & NSP OTR (One Time Registration) Number
SC Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Current Year College Admission Letter & Tuition Fee Receipt
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account Passbook (first page with IFSC)

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Financial support for SC students studying in Classes 9 and 10 to prevent dropouts.
documents: SC Caste Certificate of Father / Student
School Bonafide / Enrollment Certificate from Principal
Bank Account Passbook (joint account with parent or self)

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Financial assistance for OBC students studying in Class 1 to Class 10 to reduce dropout rates.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Support for OBC students pursuing higher secondary and above education in recognised institutions.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities
description: For meritorious students belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) pursuing professional and technical courses.
documents: Admission Proof for Professional / Technical Course

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Scholarship for minority community students in Classes 1 to 10 to support school education and reduce dropouts.
documents: Previous Academic Year Marksheet (at least 50% marks)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Support for minority students pursuing Class 11 and above courses in government or private recognised institutions.
documents: Previous Qualifying Exam Marksheet (at least 50% marks)
Current Year College Admission / Fee Receipt

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10 with family income below the limit.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Central scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing post-matric education in recognised institutions.
documents: ST Tribe Certificate from Revenue Department
College Admission Slip & Tuition Fee Receipt

name: National Fellowship for ST Students (NFST)
description: Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe students admitted to M.Phil and Ph.D programmes in recognised universities.
documents: ST Certificate issued by competent authority
M.Phil / Ph.D Admission Letter & Joining Report from University
Research Supervisor & Head of Institution Recommendation Form

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
description: Merit-based scholarship for students above 80th percentile in Class 12 board exams, open to all categories. Provides ₹10,000–₹20,000 per annum.
documents: Class 12 Board Exam Marksheet (verified top 80th percentile)
College Admission Allotment Letter & Fee Receipt
Bonafide Certificate from College Principal / Dean

name: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Central Armed Police Forces
description: For wards and widows of ex-servicemen and Central Armed Police Forces personnel. Provides ₹3,000/month (boys) and ₹3,600/month (girls).
documents: Discharge Book / PPO Copy of Ex-Serviceman / CAPF Personnel
Annexure 1 & 2 signed by Competent Authority / Zila Sainik Board

name: Top Class Education for OBC/EBC/DNT Students
description: Full tuition fee support for OBC/EBC/DNT students admitted to top listed institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, etc.).
documents: Allotment Letter from Listed Top Institution (IIT/NIT/IIM/AIIMS)

name: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Financial support for differently-abled students (40%+ disability) pursuing education from Class 9 onwards.

name: E-Grantz Scholarship (Kerala) — SC/ST
description: Kerala state scholarship for SC and ST students. No income ceiling for SC/ST categories. Covers tuition, hostel, and maintenance.
documents: Nativity / Domicile Certificate of Kerala State
Qualifying Examination Marksheet (SSLC / Plus Two / Degree)
College Admission Allotment Memo & Fee Receipt
Bank Passbook (Aadhaar linked with minimum 75% attendance)

name: E-Grantz Scholarship (Kerala) — OBC
description: Kerala state scholarship for OBC students. Must be a permanent resident of Kerala with 75% minimum attendance.
documents: Income Certificate from Village Officer (family income ≤ ₹1,00,000)
Bank Account Passbook (75% minimum attendance verified)

name: C.H. Muhammed Koya Scholarship (Kerala)
description: For girl students from Muslim, Latin Catholic, and Converted Christian communities in Kerala. Must study in Govt/Aided institutions.
documents: Community Certificate (Muslim / Latin Catholic / Converted Christian)
College Admission Memo (Govt / Aided / Merit Seat in Self-Financing)

name: Suvarna Jubilee Merit Scholarship (Kerala)
description: For BPL students in Govt/Aided colleges with at least 50% marks. Open to all categories.
documents: BPL Ration Card or BPL Certificate from Local Body
First Year Admission Allotment Memo in Govt/Aided College

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
description: For meritorious students from economically weaker families studying in Class 9 to 12. ₹12,000 per annum through PFMS.
documents: Class 9 Admission Certificate in Government / Local Body / Aided School

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship for Minority Girls
description: For girl students from minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) in Classes 9 to 12 with at least 50% marks.
documents: School Verification Certificate signed by Principal

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
description: Scheme aimed at providing assistance for advancement of girls pursuing technical education (Engineering/Diploma). ₹50,000 per annum.
documents: Centralized Admission Process (CAP) Allotment Letter to AICTE-approved Degree/Diploma

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
description: Financial support for specially-abled students with more than 40% disability admitted to AICTE approved technical degree/diploma programs.
documents: Centralized Admission Allotment Letter to AICTE-approved Technical Program

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship for economically weaker students pursuing higher studies in medicine, engineering, graduation or diploma courses.
documents: Income Certificate from competent revenue officer (≤ ₹2,50,000)
Admission Letter & Fee Receipt for Higher Education / Professional Course
Cancelled Cheque or Bank Passbook copy

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE) - DST
description: For top 1% meritorious students pursuing courses in Natural & Basic Sciences (B.Sc., B.S., Int. M.Sc./M.S.). ₹80,000 per annum.
documents: Class 12 Marksheet showing Top 1% rank in State/Central Board (or JEE/NEET/KVPY rank card)
Admission Letter for B.Sc. / B.S. / Int. M.Sc. in Natural & Basic Sciences
Endorsement Certificate / Bonafide Form signed by College Principal / Registrar
State Bank of India (SBI) Bank Account Passbook (mandatory for DST DBT transfer)
